rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and only acted on that user’s orders. They identified the most recent delivered order, confirmed the exact items to return and the refund method before performing any write, calculated the correct refund total based on item prices, and then executed the return on the delivered order. The tool response confirms the return was requested with the specified items and PayPal as the refund method. Final information given to the user (refund amount and next steps) matches tool data. No policy violations observed.
